description: The literature and software this project's method rests on, one entry per work, each mapped to the block or component that uses it. Hand-curated: it is the project's reading list, not the corpus the system retrieves from.
verification_note: Every arXiv entry's title, year and author list was fetched from the arXiv API on that date rather than typed from memory. The four non-arXiv works and the four libraries are hand-entered and carry 'source': 'hand-entered'.

entries.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
entries.used_for: BERT: the pretraining recipe behind both the block 1 classifier and the block 6 NLI model.

entries.title: Attention Is All You Need
entries.used_for: The Transformer architecture underneath every model in the stack.

entries.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
entries.used_for: Knowledge distillation: why a 66M distilled classifier is enough for block 1.

entries.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
entries.used_for: Dense passage retrieval: the dense-only retrieval the graph uses by default.

entries.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
entries.used_for: The original RAG formulation this project extends with agency.

entries.title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models through Question Complexity
entries.used_for: Adaptive-RAG: routing a question by complexity, the same idea as block 1 at a coarser grain.

entries.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
entries.used_for: FLARE: the 'active retrieval' in this project's title; decides when retrieval is needed rather than always retrieving.

entries.title: When Not to Trust Language Models: Investigating Effectiveness of Parametric and Non-Parametric Memories
entries.used_for: Evidence that always retrieving is not optimal, and that a model's own knowledge should decide.

entries.title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter
entries.used_for: DistilBERT: the exact base model fine-tuned as the retrieve/skip classifier (distilbert-base-uncased).

entries.title: Query Rewriting for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
entries.used_for: Query rewriting for RAG: the rewrite step in block 2.

entries.title: Measuring and Narrowing the Compositionality Gap in Language Models
entries.used_for: Self-Ask: the multi-hop decomposition that block 2 performs for compositional questions.

entries.area: Blocks 3 and 4 - sufficiency critic and retry loop
entries.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
entries.used_for: Corrective RAG: judging retrieved evidence and acting on a negative verdict, as the sufficiency critic does.

entries.area: Blocks 3 and 4 - sufficiency critic and retry loop
entries.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
entries.used_for: Reflexion: carrying verbal critic feedback into the next attempt, which is what the retry loop passes to the reformulator.

entries.area: Blocks 3 and 4 - sufficiency critic and retry loop
entries.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
entries.used_for: Self-RAG: the closest prior art to this whole design - retrieve, critique with reflection tokens, generate.

entries.area: Blocks 3 and 4 - sufficiency critic and retry loop
entries.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
entries.used_for: Self-Refine: the iterate-on-own-output loop that block 4 bounds with max_retries.

entries.area: Blocks 3 and 4 - sufficiency critic and retry loop
entries.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
entries.used_for: ReAct: interleaving reasoning and acting, the pattern the LangGraph state machine implements.

entries.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
entries.used_for: Qwen2.5: the local generator, qwen2.5:3b-instruct, served by Ollama.

entries.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
entries.used_for: Lost in the middle: why the number of contexts shown to the generator is a tunable worth ablating (max_contexts).

entries.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
entries.used_for: Chain-of-thought prompting, which informs the prompt design in src/agents/prompts.py.

entries.title: DeBERTaV3: Improving DeBERTa using ELECTRA-Style Pre-Training with Gradient-Disentangled Embedding Sharing
entries.used_for: DeBERTaV3: the exact variant that verifier model is built on.

entries.title: DeBERTa: Decoding-enhanced BERT with Disentangled Attention
entries.used_for: DeBERTa: the backbone of the verifier model cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base.

entries.title: A Broad-Coverage Challenge Corpus for Sentence Understanding through Inference
entries.used_for: MultiNLI: the cross-domain half of that training data, which is why the verifier transfers to arXiv text.

entries.title: A large annotated corpus for learning natural language inference
entries.used_for: SNLI: part of the entailment training data that makes the verifier's labels meaningful.

entries.title: MiniLM: Deep Self-Attention Distillation for Task-Agnostic Compression of Pre-Trained Transformers
entries.used_for: MiniLM: all-MiniLM-L6-v2, the configured embedding model, is a MiniLM distillation.

entries.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
entries.used_for: Sentence-BERT: the bi-encoder design behind the sentence-transformers embedder.

entries.title: The Faiss library
entries.used_for: The current FAISS library reference for the section 11 benchmark.

entries.title: Billion-scale similarity search with GPUs
entries.used_for: FAISS: the flat exact-search baseline recall is measured against.

entries.title: Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs
entries.used_for: HNSW: the index Qdrant uses, and the algorithm whose ef parameter section 11 sweeps.

entries.title: Product Quantization for Nearest Neighbor Search
entries.reference: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 33(1), 117-128
entries.used_for: The quantization family behind Qdrant's int8 scalar quantization, benchmarked in section 11.

entries.area: Hybrid retrieval and reranking (built, not used)
entries.title: Passage Re-ranking with BERT
entries.used_for: Cross-encoder passage reranking, as implemented in src/index/hybrid.py.

entries.area: Hybrid retrieval and reranking (built, not used)
entries.title: MS MARCO: A Human Generated MAchine Reading COmprehension Dataset
entries.used_for: MS MARCO: the training data of the configured reranker, cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2.

entries.area: Hybrid retrieval and reranking (built, not used)
entries.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Outperforms Condorcet and Individual Rank Learning Methods
entries.used_for: Reciprocal rank fusion, how the dense and BM25 result lists are combined in src/index/hybrid.py.

entries.area: Hybrid retrieval and reranking (built, not used)
entries.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
entries.reference: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval 3(4), 333-389
entries.used_for: BM25, the lexical half of hybrid retrieval; the configured k1 = 1.5 and b = 0.75 are this framework's parameters.

entries.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
entries.used_for: LLM-as-a-judge: the pattern the sufficiency critic and the RAGAS judge both rely on, and its known biases.

entries.title: Ragas: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
entries.used_for: RAGAS: the faithfulness and answer-relevancy metrics reported in section 10.

entries.title: SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text
entries.used_for: SQuAD: the token-F1 scoring that relaxed accuracy uses for its F1 >= 0.8 criterion.

entries.title: An Introduction to the Bootstrap
entries.used_for: The 95% bootstrap confidence intervals on every accuracy number and every paired ablation difference.

entries.title: MultiHop-RAG: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Queries
entries.used_for: MultiHop-RAG: the multi-hop and null-question evaluation set; the source of the abstention numbers.

entries.title: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
entries.used_for: HotpotQA (distractor, validation): the multi-hop evaluation set, in its own Qdrant collection.

entries.title: HuggingFace's Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing
entries.used_for: Hugging Face Transformers: the Trainer used to fine-tune the block 1 classifier.

entries.title: LangGraph
entries.used_for: The StateGraph that wires blocks 1-6 together and bounds the retry loop.

entries.title: Ollama
entries.used_for: Serves the local generator, which is what keeps generation free.

entries.title: Qdrant
entries.used_for: The vector database: HNSW index, int8 scalar quantization, gRPC transport.
